# Allowlist for .github/scripts/check-deploy-coverage.sh
#
# Released components that ArgoCD deploys but which auto-deploy's ALL_SERVICES legitimately
# does NOT build — because a DIFFERENT pipeline builds them.
#
# STRICT SCOPE. This file answers one question: "is this component built by something else?"
# It is NOT a place to park a service that nobody builds yet. A component with a gitops
# manifest and no builder has a tag that rots in place; the failure surfaces weeks later,
# when a pod reschedules and cannot be admitted (2026-07-16: keycloak, sepa-payment). If you
# are tempted to add an entry because "we'll wire it up later", the honest move is to wire it
# up or drop the manifest.
#
# One component name per line, exact match.

# admin-ui is built and deployed by .github/workflows/admin-ui-deploy.yml, which runs the
# full Next.js build, bakes the CI evidence bundles, and pushes via build-push-admin-ui.sh.
# It is intentionally outside the ~34-service Quarkus fan-out.
openbank-admin-ui
